test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: According to the Mediation Bill, 2021, the mediation process must be completed within 180 days, which may be extended by another ______ days by the parties.
solution:
The correct answer is __**180 days.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Mediation Bill, 2021** mandates that the mediation process must be completed within this time frame of** 180 days.**
 
• The parties involved in the mediation process may extend the time frame by **another 30 days only.**
 
• This extension is allowed **only once** and cannot be extended further.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Mediation is a process in which a **neutral third party **helps parties in a **dispute** to reach a mutually acceptable agreement.
 
• It is an alternative to litigation and is often** less costly and time-consuming.**
 
• The Mediation Bill, 2021 was introduced in the **Lok Sabha on February 5, 2021,** and passed on **March 15, 2021.**
 
• It aims to provide a** legal framework **for the mediation process in India.
 
• The Bill also provides for the establishment of a **National Mediation Council and State Mediation Councils **to promote mediation as a means of dispute resolution.
 
• The Bill also provides for the **confidentiality of the mediation process **and prohibits the use of information obtained during mediation in any other legal proceedings.
